# Design point P015

## Description

This would expose a filesystem-resident repository through an HTTP daemon while coordinating state changes with distant replicas via multiple network round trips. However, the placement choice is marked rejected, so this combination does not represent an accepted system design, despite the coordination approach being accepted.
